description: This file defines a React component 'MultiverseBranchingMap' that renders a complex, interactive, lane-based multiverse map visualization with nodes, paths, edges, and user interactions such as zooming, panning, and node selection.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom React hook to detect if user has requested reduced motion.

methods.name: IconMinus
methods.description: SVG icon component representing a minus sign for zoom out control.

methods.name: IconPlus
methods.description: SVG icon component representing a plus sign for zoom in control.

methods.name: IconReset
methods.description: SVG icon component representing a reset icon for resetting view.

methods.name: NodeCircle
methods.description: Component representing a circular node with hover and click interactions.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions for nodes and lanes in the map layout, including spacing and margins.
